title: Stair Generator
text: 离散时间或连续时间阶梯信号发生器；输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Time (s)} 指定转换时间、{Amplitude} 指定阶梯信号值的幅值、{Repeat stair pattern indefinitely} 指定阶梯模式重复、{Output data type} 输出数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Time (s)
params.values: 转换时间 [0.5 1 3 3.5] (default) | row vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Amplitude
params.values: 阶梯信号值的幅值 [1 -1 2.5 0] (default) | row vector

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar

params.name: Repeat stair pattern indefinitely
params.values: 阶梯模式重复 off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 指定输出数据类型 double (default) | Inherit: auto | Inherit: Inherit via internal rule | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 |
